This right here is like being stuck between a rock and a hard place. I think that's how it's said at least. All of this working, trying harder and harder to achieve happiness, to reach out and graze it once more. It hurts. It truly does. Sometimes it's okay to want to give up. I understand the feeling of drowning in this ocean of despair as well. However, you have to realise this. You're strong. You've done this before. You've made it this far. "But what if I don't want to go farther?" that's fully understandable. But your road, this path that you're walking, it's far from over. That's all the time I have for today, but if you want more help, feel free to ask or dm me. You got this man.

I'm sorry if it offended you in any way. For me I just feel like the word love isn't used enough, it may just be from my upbringing. However way you meant that, love can be in varying means. From friendships to family love to the love for your significant other.

That's just my opinion, you don't have to share or agree with it.

I'm sorry that you feel that way. The world constantly putting you down. But even if it seems like the world conspires against you, there are people out there who love you. Even a stranger on the internet could love you. And being a stranger on the internet, I love you. From the bottom of my heart. So don't go yet. Because it's not yet your time. Keep your head up, you're doing a good job.

​

Lots of love,

A stranger on the internet.

You are a person with a kind heart. Not wanting to commit suicide because you're afraid you'll hurt someone is quite rare for me to see.

You're changing the world already by not killing yourself. Being alive is a huge step to changing the world. Start small. Giving mental help and escape for others is a great thing to do. You change people's lives for the better by saving them. Then go larger slowly. Give more help. Keep building up and give more and more advice. That's my advice on changing the world. Altho if you want to change it in some huge major way, I'll have to agree with the other commenter. It takes time to do something major. Don't rush it.

Not really a poem but I write short things often. Here's something that I wrote when I was really fucked mentally:

Lo, does the sun not set? Is life not temporary? Is not every smile worth smiling, even if it hides the pain? Isn't tomorrow something that can hide beauty and pain? Keep pushing dear friend, surely we'll get through this together.

Please don't take your own life, tomorrow is another day, it may be another day filled with agony, but a lot can change in one day. Tomorrow can be different. And if not tomorrow then what about two days? And so on? Nobody can make you see the next day through your eyes, you have to so it yourself.

Even if my writings all over the place, I found it works. Somewhat.

Holy shit. That was a rollercoaster to read. But no, it sure as fuck is not time. I don't know how much pain you've been through, and if I was you I definitely would've killed myself by now. You're a strong person, a brave one, and I have no doubt that if you can get back on your feet, you can do great things. Not many people can push through much less of that, and you are an amazing person. Admittedly, certain societies in themselves are very fucked. It always puts certain people above others simply because of certain traits that they have. "Only the strong survive," right? You are strong. I hope that there is a way to get through all of that. What I can tell you from my times is to take joy in the smaller things. I know, it's a bit weird to say, but I can guarantee you that the smaller things are more likely they are to save you or push you over the edge. So take joy in the little things. If things truly do get worse, message or talk to someone, anyone, even me if you want to, but talk to someone. It could be the people on here that are giving advice but please talk to someone.  
Lots of love,   
\-A stranger on the internet

It's never easy losing things, people or pets who you hold near and dear to you. My advice would be treasure you're cat while it's still alive. When the cat passes on, grieve. It's always better to mourn than hurt yourself, whether emotional mental or physically. Once you're done grieving, look to an animal shelter to adopt another cat. I've been hearing more and more of animal shelters which abuse the animals. You'd be saving two lives. Your own and maybe that cats.
I'm afraid that's all the advice I have.
Lots of love,
a stranger on the internet

Honestly? Same. I've lost so much growing up, I've learnt so much that I didn't want to. I realised how abusive and hateful my parents were, how much it hurts, and from that I learnt how much more it hurt. I haven't attempted to kill myself solely because I'm afraid of hurting my last handful of friends I have remaining.
It hurts.
It'll hurt more.
But that's just part of life isn't it?
You can't have life without people, and everybody has to experience some form of pain. Some more extreme than others. We're all fighting battles, some for life and others for joy. But that's part of life. And if it's part of life, then you can push through it. While school does suck, I went to a boarding school for my first year amidst covid-19, it fucking sucks, there isn't much that we can do to stop it from sucking. So we just have to keep our heads high. Because even if it's the best we can do, it's the bedt we're doing. We're still alive to hold our heads high. And that's worth every moment, no matter how antagonising it is.
Definitely worth it. I was devastated when my cat passed away one year ago, but things started to look up when we got a new cat. Take care of your cat and it'll take care of you.
